rationale: All six generation checks fell inside the ~8-point sampling-noise band (base 0.578). 120302_651 (amplify x5 the writes of early Gated-DeltaNet layers L0,1,2,4 along d_a, the residual direction that the decay gates of all 288 DeltaNet heads read with the same sign) had the best observed result: prompt_strict 0.625 (+4.7), inst_strict 0.746 vs 0.728, rescues 15 / losses 9, fewer cut responses (0.0625 vs 0.078), and it improves generic LM log-prob (neutral +0.010). 115957_748 is the opposite-sign control of the same knob (prompt 0.594, best inst_strict 0.750, rescues 17 / losses 15, cut 0.047) but its neutral is slightly over the limit (-0.0125). 122209_766 is a reweighted d_a variant with the best neutral (+0.026) that matched base on IFEval (0.578, net 0). Because both signs of the d_a knob scored +1.6 to +4.7, the knob shows no directional IFEval effect. Expected held-out gain for all three is small (roughly 0 to +2 points), and the order mostly reflects observed scores, with neutral used as a tie-break.
